gameLoop: Swap two neighbouring gems on a 7x7 board to line up three or more of the same kind. Cleared gems score, the board falls and refills, and cascades pay a bonus.

obstacles.role: every accepted swap costs one of 25 moves
when no move is left the board reshuffles, which costs no moves but breaks any plan

collectibles: Gems score 10 points each; cascades add 50% per level.
progression: Five gem kinds on a 7x7 board; a reshuffle happens only when no move is left.
scoring: 10 points per cleared gem, plus a 50% bonus for each cascade level.
winCondition: Reach 1300 points before the moves run out.
loseCondition: Run out of moves below the target.
notes: Demo blueprint for the puzzle-match template.
